budget_items.topic: Town Counsel budget cap, MGL Ch. 56 Sect. 60 complaint
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Manager recommended a budget not to exceed $3000 for Town Counsel's participation; the motion carried with that cap.
budget_items.quote: ms. speidel spoke to say that she would recommend a budget not to exceed $3000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Counsel estimated 5-15 hours of work if the matter is done quickly; no dollar figure was given.
budget_items.quote: mr. bard replied that he thought it could be 5-15 hours, if it is done quickly.

budget_items.topic: Sign program and pavement management software cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The sign inventory and pavement management computer program cost $11,700, to be funded from leftover Chapter 90 funds; a board member asked whether that figure included integrating existing data.
budget_items.quote: the cost for this program will be $11,700 and will be funded from left over chapter 90 funds

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Proceeds from recycling metal from replaced signs are returned to the Town's General Fund; no amount was given.
budget_items.quote: mr. rodriquenz answered that there is and that the money is returned to the town's general fund.

budget_items.topic: Track and field turf and track replacement cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Estimated cost of about $700,000 to replace the turf and resurface the track at the new field; the Capital Plan typically spends $300,000 to $600,000 in one year.
budget_items.quote: he said that we are looking at around $700,000 to pull the turf up, replace with top of the line turf, and resurface the track.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Speidel said the Capital Plan spends between $300,000 and $600,000 in any one year against a $700,000 project, so borrowing within the levy will be needed.
budget_items.quote: the concern with the capital plan is that in any one year we spend between $300,000 - $600,000 and this is a $700,000 project.

budget_items.topic: Track and field user fees and turf replacement reserve
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Field operations are paid from user fees, which do not cover turf replacement; a prior plan to raise fees and set aside a portion for turf replacement was not carried out.
budget_items.quote: the current operations and maintenance of the field is paid for through user fees

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Speidel said the Town will likely need to borrow within the levy in the next couple of years to cover the Town's share of the turf project; no amount was given.
budget_items.quote: she believes we will need to borrow within the levy to cover whatever portion of this turf project

budget_items.topic: Track and field fee collection question
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Matthews asked whether any fee has been collected from the Track & Field Association toward future turf and track replacement; no amount was given.
budget_items.quote: questioned whether or not any type of fee has been collected from the track & field association for future replacement/maintenance of the turf and track

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Discussion of a possible Payment in Lieu of Taxes (PILOT) arrangement and an appraisal for the Eagle Heights property, alongside possible State grant funding and tax credits; no amount was given.
budget_items.quote: has discussed some sort of pilot (payment in lieu of taxes) for that property

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Speidel would like to pay the LSP a small retainer to go to DEP for guidance on the privately owned 925 Mass Ave property; no amount was given and it has not moved forward.
budget_items.quote: she would like to pay the lsp a small retainer to go to dep (department environmental protection)
